verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that Superhuman can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender in one action. That is a narrow bulk-triage capability, not arbitrary multi-selection of conversations. Auto Archive is AI automation rather than user-driven bulk selection, and Cmd+K's 'any action' claim says nothing about multi-select, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: documented arbitrary multi-select of conversations, bulk archive and bulk label on a user-chosen selection, first-party docs for bulk actions, and hands-on corroboration beyond a single comment.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke

citations.quote: When deleting, you can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender.
